info.name: Multi Branch POS API
info.description:
# Multi Branch POS API

This collection covers the full backend API for a **multi-branch Point of Sale (POS) system**. It is organized into 8 functional modules, providing 37 endpoints to manage all core operations across branches — from authentication and product management to order processing, inventory tracking, and cross-branch data synchronization.

## Modules

| Module | Endpoints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Auth** | 3 | User login, profile retrieval, and logout |
| **Products** | 7 | Full CRUD for products, plus pagination support |
| **Branches** | 5 | Create, read, update, and delete branch records |
| **Customers** | 7 | Customer management with validation error cases (invalid email/phone) |
| **Inventory** | 5 | Per-branch inventory tracking with full CRUD |
| **Orders** | 5 | Order creation, retrieval, history, and deletion |
| **Sync** | 4 | Cross-branch order synchronization and status management |
| **Dashboard** | 1 | Aggregated stats across all branches |

## Getting Started

Set the `base_url` variable in your active environment to point to your target server. Use the **Auth** folder to log in and obtain a token, then proceed with any other module.
